description: This source file is a shell script that manages the setup and running of an OpenClaw instance in a Podman container environment. It includes functions for environment setup, token generation, configuration validation, and container lifecycle management (launch or onboarding). The script handles user permissions, SELinux considerations, environment variable management, and establishes networking ports and mounts for the containerized application.

methods.name: resolve_user_home
methods.description: Resolves the home directory for a specified user using getent or /etc/passwd.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and terminates the script.

methods.name: validate_single_line_value
methods.description: Ensures a value does not contain control characters.

methods.name: validate_absolute_path
methods.description: Checks if a path is absolute, without repeated slashes or dot path segments.

methods.name: validate_mount_source_path
methods.description: Validates that a source path for a mount is an absolute path without colon characters.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_regular_file
methods.description: Checks if a file exists, is not a symlink, and is a regular file.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_dir
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists, is not a symlink.

methods.name: stat_uid
methods.description: Retrieves the UID of a file or directory.

methods.name: stat_mode
methods.description: Retrieves the permission mode of a file or directory.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_dir_owned_by_user
methods.description: Checks directory ownership and permissions for safety.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_regular_file_owned_by_user
methods.description: Checks file ownership and permissions for safety.

methods.name: ensure_safe_write_file_path
methods.description: Prepares a path for safe writing, verifying directory safety.

methods.name: write_file_atomically
methods.description: Writes data to a file atomically with proper permissions.

methods.name: load_podman_env_file
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a specified env file, validating paths and keys.

methods.name: validate_port
methods.description: Ensures a port is a number within the valid range (1-65535).

methods.name: generate_token_hex_32
methods.description: Generates a 32-byte hex token using available system tools (openssl, python3, od).

methods.name: create_token_env_file
methods.description: Creates an environment file containing an authentication token.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins_via_cli
methods.description: Synchronizes 'allowedOrigins' config for the gateway using CLI or Python script.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins
methods.description: Synchronizes 'allowedOrigins' config by editing JSON files with Python or fallback.

methods.name: cleanup_token_env_file
methods.description: Removes temporary token env files on script exit.

methods.name: resolve_config_gateway_bind
methods.description: Resolves the gateway.bind setting from the openclaw config.
